www.archives.gov.stack: Drupal 7 (Drupal.settings, sites/all/modules/custom/archives_ui) + Bootstrap 3 (button 6px 12px/34px) + jQuery 1.7.2, AddToAny, CrazyEgg, DAP analytics

palette.tile-colors: duotone photo tiles, exact hex not measured (see shots/home-desktop.png)

layout.hero: 5 equal tiles x 280px wide, 320px tall at 1440 (grid 5 cols); below: 2 big promos + news column
layout.mobile: tiles stack full width 60px-text rows (120px @2x=60 css), search under logo

www.archives.gov.dark_theme: only prefers-color-scheme rule inside AddToAny widget; site itself has none

catalog.archives.gov.stack: React 17.0.2 SPA (create-react-app: static/js/main.*.chunk.js ~815KB + 2.*.chunk.js ~2.3MB vendor) + USWDS 3 classes (usa-button, usa-input, usa-card, usa-pill, usa-modal; 336 usa-* selectors in main.css) + OpenSeadragon + IIIF Image API 3
catalog.archives.gov.iiif: https://catalog.archives.gov/iiif/3/<path-encoded>/info.json  ImageService3 level2, tiles 512x512, scaleFactors 1..16, sizes 84..1351px, maxArea 10000000; tile url e.g. .../0,0,4096,4096/512,512/0/default.jpg

palette.toolbar-bg: measured bg colors on record page: #1a4480 (rgb 26,68,128), #276dc1 (rgb 39,109,193) for Log in/Search buttons; toolbar strip visually #264a87 not measured

layout.viewer: full-bleed 1264px wide x 656px high, bg #1b1b1b, right rail 176px (thumbnails with page numbers, 'Show Details' toggle)

motion.skeleton: classes .block-load/.block-load-anim: animation shine 2s linear infinite; results page shows 4 card skeletons (80x80 thumb + 5 text bars) and facet skeleton

viewer.lib: OpenSeadragon (round PNG controls /images/openseadragon/{zoomin,zoomout,home}_{rest,grouphover,hover,pressed}.png) + vertical page thumbnail rail + tab bar Transcription/Tags/Comments/Extracted Text with counters
viewer.mobile: controls in top-left, rail collapses, header collapses to Menu + Log in, search under it, 'Collapse' button for breadcrumb

home.bodyClass: html front not-logged-in no-sidebars page-node  nara-catalog-api-processed
